text_block_list.text:
One day in mid-March.
Seiun Sky was, for once, lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, not really,
it's not that big of a deal, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
Could I get your opinion for a second?

According to Seiun Sky... the other day,
when she invited Nishino Flower on a "date" to Ligne Droite—

Apparently, she was told,
"Please let me think about it a little."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And that is how it goes, boo-hoo-hoo...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, I wonder if she was mad that I fell asleep
in the middle of our chat the other day~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Or... was it really bad of me to startle them
while they were tending the flowers, I wonder~?"

Though their tone is frivolous and playful,
their expression is faintly somber.
It seems they are fairly down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
And here I thought you'd agree right away~.

"What if they hate me?"
I felt like those words were written all over
her face as she stared blankly into space.
choice_data_list: If they wanted to refuse, they would do so right away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: There must be some reason for it, right?
Isn't there some reason for it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So it's not... that you hate it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I, see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you, Trainer.
Having returned to his usual self, Seiun Sky muttered, "Well then, first things first—it's all about information gathering," before leaving the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Dancing really is tough...
I wonder if I'll ever get good at it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Isn't that—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? The flower goes here,
and I wrap this stem around this way...? 
Urrrgh...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A flower crown, you say?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flower. Fufufu, that's right~ It's a gift for the flower fairy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's pretty difficult.
I wonder if a poorly made flower crown like this
works as a gift.”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, skill doesn't matter at all.
I'm sure they'll love it! Because you're putting your whole heart into making it, Sky-san...!

The moment she heard those words—
Seiun Sky's troubled expression shifted into a sly grin.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Flower, about that reply to the droits...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Did you really hate it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No way would I mind! Going to
Dreux with you is gonna be so much fun, Sky-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still... you're so good at dancing, so I thought
I'd reply once I got better too.
...I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Flower.
I'm just repeating what someone else said, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Prom isn't a place to compete over dance skills,
it's a place to make memories, they say."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to be great at dancing.
Let's just make memories together.

Seiun Sky gently placed the "Clumsy Flower Crown"
onto Nishino Flower's head.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Little Flower Fairy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait, what?!
A fairy—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: “Skill doesn't matter”... right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Well... that's, um—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. ...Ehehe.
A few days later, I spotted Seiun Sky heading out to the turf track with a smiling Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching memory regarding Nishino Flower-san's concerns—
One match found from a conversation last night at 21:41.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Determining that communicating this will aid in resolution.
Replaying the conversation from that time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“I was invited on a 'date' to the soirée,
and Sky-san is actually quite a good dancer...”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
""I don't have much confidence in myself,
so I was worried I might end up embarrassing you...""

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"So right now, I'm practicing in a hurry.
Once I get good at it, I want to reply properly."
—That is all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
...Ah, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? Minor "shock" detected
in Seiun Sky's facial expression.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, true~ Even Sei-chan was a biiiit surprised by that."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Like this, and like that...
Ugh, this is so hard after all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I really should turn it down...
But still..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I turn Sky-san down,
I wonder if she'll go with someone else.

Ta-da! Pop quiz time.
What's the most important thing when practicing dance?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah!
Sky-san...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The answer is... having fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance together, Flower.
I'm sure it'll be way more fun if it's the two of us.

Seiun Sky took Nishino Flower's hand
and began to dance while gently leading her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
One, two, turn...
Take a big step, and spin around.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...A-And a spin...!
Whoa, I did it!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Flower really catches on quick, doesn't she?
Hmm, alright then, next we spin together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Twirl...! Fufu!
Dancing really is fun, isn't it?
A few days later, I spotted Seiun Sky heading out to the turf track with a smiling Nishino Flower.
